content.value: Some equipment requires [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]] or [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Check the requirements on the item itself: its tooltip shows the values for that specific piece, including any requirement reductions.
Your character attributes are compared with each requirement. Unmet requirements appear in red. Increasing the relevant attribute or using Reduced Requirements can help you meet them.
Reduced Requirements scales each nonzero requirement and rounds the result to the nearest whole point. Check the updated item tooltip to see the resulting requirements.

Equipment can still be used when its requirements are not met, but its item-derived modifiers are reduced by half, including final attack and reload speed handling. The penalty ends when every listed requirement is met.
See [[article/stats|Reading Your Stats]] for your current attributes and [[article/equipment|Equipment]] for the equipment systems.
